label: Oxon Advisory calculation, 2025/26 prices, HM Treasury GDP deflator
deflators: src/data/deflators.csv (HM Treasury, June 2026 Quarterly National Accounts)

method.financial: amount × 100 ÷ financial-year index for the price year (2025/26 = 100).
method.calendar: amount × 100 ÷ (0.25 × index for the financial year ending in March of that calendar year + 0.75 × index for the financial year starting in April), because nine months of a calendar year fall in the later financial year.

rules: One £ figure per entry, quoted exactly from the value field. Ratios, percentages, counts, DALYs and US$ figures are not rebased. Entries with no stated price year, an approximate year, a range of years, or a year later than the latest deflator outturn are left out. Cost-effectiveness ratios (cost per QALY or per healthy year) are not rebased.
